messages:
clara: Quick sync 1: I put up a docs PR that swaps the old heatmap example to use the telemetry wrapper + new cost attribution fields. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5180

jord: Saw it, thanks. Does it also update the dashboard query that populates the latency slice? we had a mismatch in the example vs console behavior.

clara: It does but only in the Rust snippet. I kept the TS snippet minimal and omitted the span sampling example. We should show a tiny span sample + cost attribution combo.

nalin: We should keep snippets small but real-world. Suggest: add a 2-line TypeScript snippet showing trace start + addCostBreakdown call, then link to the larger example in a hidden full-example file.

clara: Good plan. I'll add the two-line TS example and a "See full example" link to console/examples/heatmap-full.md.

build-bot: CI: docs lint OK. link-check: 2 warnings (redirects) detected.

jord: One redirect is the old telemetry guide, the other is the dashboards migration doc. Can you update both in this PR? small followup otherwise we'll get churn.

clara: I'll patch both. Nalin, can you quick-review the wording on the cost section? I tried to be explicit about "tokens vs cache hits" but kept it brief.

nalin: reviewing now. Also, add a short QA step: "open sample org -> run heatmap for 30s -> compare cost breakdown lines (generation vs KV-cache)". People skip this otherwise.

alicja: FYI SRE: we should call out that KV-cache attribution depends on prefix caching being enabled on the runtime; otherwise cost will show as generation-only. Small note under "prereqs"?

sre: +1. Add the runtime flag detail. Could tuck it into a footnote.

clara: Added TS snippet and the prereq footnote. Also updated both redirected links to canonical docs.redwood.ai paths. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5180/files

jord: Quick nit: replace "kv cache" with "KV-cache" (hyphen) and mention "prefix-aware attribution".

clara: Done. Also added the short QA checklist to the PR description.

build-bot: preview-site: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/5180  smoke: link-check warnings cleared after edits.

nalin: LGTM for content. Small wording nit around "cost/latency breakdown" -> "cost & latency breakdowns" for consistency across docs.

clara: fixed wording and added a tiny fenced code block showing span start + addCostBreakdown:
```
// TS snippet
const span = telemetry.startSpan('heatmap.render')
telemetry.addCostBreakdown(span, { generation: 120, kv_cache: 30 })
span.end()
```

jord: looks good. Approving after CI green.

clara: I'll merge once CI passes and then add an entry to docs/changelog/2026-03.md noting the migration note and heatmap example change. Will ping #docs when done.

nalin: thanks! this should reduce confusion for internal QA and users checking cost splits. :party:
